text_block_list.text:
Vodka was defeated by Daiwa Scarlet in
the 
"Tulip Sho." Both feeling how much
they've 
grown, they promised each other a rematch.

However,
to compete against Daiwa Scarlet, 
who was walking the Tiara route,
she would 
have to abandon the Classic Triple Crown 
path.

Normally, switching routes mid-way after 
pursuing the Tiara route would be 
unthinkable...

Facing her rival versus chasing her 
dream... Unwilling to give up on either, 
Vodka puts her choice on hold and heads 
for the Oka Sho.
